'''December 2001 Colorado Springs tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Colorado Springs, Colorado on 9 December 2001. It is known from Dan H's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3163">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-12-9-01huge-turnout-2-colo-sprgs-cod3163/ 12-9-01huge-turnout-2-colo-sprgs-co], DeckTech (Dan "Gil-galad" H, 12 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-12-9-01huge-turnout-2-colo-sprgs-cod3163/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Colorado Springs, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 19
